findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks existing service callers
findings.body: This change removes the public `findMany` method and replaces it with `getBaseConditions`, but does not update any callers. Existing code that invokes `InsightsBookingService.findMany(...)` will fail type-checking (or fail at runtime if it bypasses types), breaking the service API. Preserve the method or migrate all callers to execute the raw query before merging.
